Preserve the explicit temporal reversal:short-run inequity versus long-run improvement,about27years to regain the initial level and GEI66.80before versus74.67after50years. Redistribution intensity and middle-country participation are separate scenario changes;their conditional improvements do not establish benefits from mining alone. The final mandatory/incentive proposals follow the modeled allocation mechanism. No current policy-law assertion or formula verification.
